description: Pre-connection onboarding helper, callable before any SMI token is set. With no input, returns the fork question "Do you already have an SMI token?" — call again with hasToken: "yes" for connect guidance (then verify_access), or hasToken: "no" for prospect-intake guidance. Runs locally; makes no network calls and never reads or requires credentials.

hasToken.description: Answer to the fork question "Do you already have an SMI token?" — omit on the first call to receive the question.

name: onboarding_next_step
title: SMI Onboarding Next Step
